measured_on: NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition (sm_120), driver 580.178.04, Triton 3.7.1, vLLM 0.27.1. Flash-linear-attention kernels: the fastest summed time over the keys a cold start of the chunked gated-delta kernel at the model's shapes recorded. w8a8_block_dynamic_fp8_matmul_kernel keeps no timing records; two cold starts chose num_stages=4 for the branch-sized key (M=16) and num_stages=2 for longer inputs; num_stages=4 needs 160 KiB of shared memory at the longer shapes, above this card's 99 KiB, so the entry is num_stages=2, valid for every shape.
